column3: NKJV has “minister of God, and our fellow laborer,” following the Textus Receptus; the critical text reads “God's fellow worker.”
NKJV has “our Lord Jesus Christ,” following the Textus Receptus; the critical text reads “our Lord Jesus.”
NKJV has “our Lord Jesus Christ” and ends without “Amen,” following the Textus Receptus; the critical text reads “our Lord Jesus” and ends with “Amen.”
